tweets.text: INFRASTRUCTURE UPDATE: After decades of neglect, the Bipartisan Infrastructure Deal makes critical investments across our country to repair and rebuild our infrastructure. Here are some of the most historic parts of the deal:

tweets.text: The Bipartisan Infrastructure Deal will make the largest investment in public transit in history — it will repair and upgrade aging infrastructure, modernize bus and rail fleets, make stations accessible to all users, and bring transit service to new communities.

tweets.text: The Bipartisan Infrastructure Deal invests $66B to eliminate the Amtrak maintenance backlog, modernize the Northeast Corridor, and bring world-class rail service to new areas. It is the largest investment in passenger rail since the creation of Amtrak 50 years ago.

tweets.text: Too often, transportation investments have divided communities or excluded those most in need. The Bipartisan Infrastructure Deal creates the first-ever program to reconnect communities – investing $1B in planning, design, demolition, reconstruction of street grids, and more.

tweets.text: The Bipartisan Infrastructure Deal is the largest investment in clean drinking water and waste water in American history, delivering clean drinking water to millions of families. It will replace all of the nation’s lead pipes and service lines.
